original_question:
Write a synthesizable Verilog module named `s5` that implements a lookup table (or substitution box) based on the input value.

The module should have the following interface:
- An input named `stage1_input` which is 6 bits wide.
- An output named `stage1_output` which is 4 bits wide.

The mapping from the decimal value of `stage1_input` to the decimal value of `stage1_output` is defined by the following table:

| stage1_input | stage1_output | | stage1_input | stage1_output | | stage1_input | stage1_output | | stage1_input | stage1_output |
|--------------|---------------| |--------------|---------------| |--------------|---------------| |--------------|---------------|
| 0            | 2             | | 16           | 8             | | 32           | 4             | | 48           | 15            |
| 1            | 14            | | 17           | 5             | | 33           | 11            | | 49           | 6             |
| 2            | 12            | | 18           | 5             | | 34           | 2             | | 50           | 9             |
| 3            | 11            | | 19           | 0             | | 35           | 8             | | 51           | 15            |
| 4            | 4             | | 20           | 3             | | 36           | 1             | | 52           | 12            |
| 5            | 2             | | 21           | 15            | | 37           | 12            | | 53           | 0             |
| 6            | 1             | | 22           | 15            | | 38           | 11            | | 54           | 5             |
| 7            | 12            | | 23           | 10            | | 39           | 7             | | 55           | 9             |
| 8            | 7             | | 24           | 13            | | 40           | 10            | | 56           | 6             |
| 9            | 4             | | 25           | 3             | | 41           | 1             | | 57           | 10            |
| 10           | 10            | | 26           | 0             | | 42           | 13            | | 58           | 3             |
| 11           | 7             | | 27           | 9             | | 43           | 14            | | 59           | 4             |
| 12           | 11            | | 28           | 14            | | 44           | 7             | | 60           | 0             |
| 13           | 13            | | 29           | 8             | | 45           | 2             | | 61           | 5             |
| 14           | 6             | | 30           | 9             | | 46           | 8             | | 62           | 14            |
| 15           | 1             | | 31           | 6             | | 47           | 13            | | 63           | 3             |

Implement this functionality in Verilog.
